name: TooltipPopup
description: Combines `Tooltip.PortalPrimitive`, `Tooltip.PositionerPrimitive`, and `Tooltip.PopupPrimitive` into a single part. Use `portalElement` or `positionerElement` to replace the portal or positioner. Renders a `<div>` element.

props.name: className
props.description:
CSS class applied to the element, or a function that
returns a class based on the component's state.

props.name: portalElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Tooltip.PortalPrimitive`. Use to change the portal container.

props.name: positionerElement
props.description: Replaces the default `Tooltip.PositionerPrimitive`. Use to change the side, alignment, or offset of the popup.

props.name: style
props.description:
Style applied to the element, or a function that
returns a style object based on the component's state.

props.name: render
props.detailedType: ReactElement | ((props: HTMLProps, state: Tooltip.Popup.State) => ReactElement) | undefined
props.description:
Allows you to replace the component's HTML element
with a different tag, or compose it with another component.

Accepts a `ReactElement` or a function that returns the element to render.
